mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id, uc.card_product_id, cp.card_name, i.card_company_name, cp.card_image_url, cp.card_type, uc.last4, uc.scheduled_payment_amount FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT uc.card_product_id, cp.card_name, i.card_company_name, cp.card_type FROM user_card uc JOIN card_product cp ON cp.card_product_id = uc.card_product_id JOIN issuer i ON i.issuer_id = cp.issuer_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.user_card_id = #{cardId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0

SELECT bs.service_id, bs.plan_group_id, bs.benefit_name, bs.benefit_type, bs.value_type, bs.value_number, bs.min_payment_amount, bs.max_payment_amount, pc.currency_name, bt.tier_id, bt.tier_order, bt.min_prev_month_spend, bt.max_prev_month_spend FROM benefit_service bs LEFT JOIN point_currency pc ON pc.point_currency_id = bs.point_currency_id LEFT JOIN benefit_tier bt ON (bs.plan_group_id IS NOT NULL AND bt.plan_group_id = bs.plan_group_id) OR (bs.plan_group_id IS NULL AND bt.service_id = bs.service_id) WHERE bs.card_product_id = #{cardProductId} ORDER BY bs.service_id, bt.tier_order, bt.tier_id

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) FROM user_card WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_card (user_id, card_product_id, first4, last4, expiry_date, display_order, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{request.cardProductId}, #{request.first4}, #{request.last4}, #{request.expiryDate}, #{displayOrder}, 0)

INSERT INTO user_card (user_id, card_product_id, first4, last4, expiry_date, bank_name, balance, credit_limit, scheduled_payment_amount, display_order, is_deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{card.cardProductId}, #{card.first4}, #{card.last4}, #{card.expiryDate}, #{card.bankName}, #{card.balance}, #{card.creditLimit}, #{card.scheduledPaymentAmount}, #{displayOrder}, 0)
